claims.statement: Canonical actor-scoped response usage revisions, topology-neutral root/child actor declarations, durable response-replacement and affiliation reducers, Claude workflow correlation, independent frozen sanitized-oracle parity, and a versioned public shadow query across Rust, N-API, and the transport-neutral SDK are implemented. Writer-owned pack readiness moves provider-stream commits through Pending to a query-visible Ready or Unavailable barrier without cursor fabrication or unrelated-stream churn, and quarantine gaps fail closed until replay. Schema v48 persists normalized support-bound source/family coverage, exposed through a generic bounded getFactFamilyCoverage contract across Rust, N-API, and the transport-neutral SDK. Its fixed-snapshot pages contain only opaque common references and deterministically cover points, absences, and errors. The common coordinator uses that coverage as a frozen per-object generation baseline for explicit usage-v2 replay: it marks Pending before reads, retracts old-generation contributions with the first replacement slice, resumes bounded work after restart, and publishes complete replacement coverage only after every provider drains. Public replay is exposed by low-level N-API and the sole-owner observation host as a stale-safe compare-and-set over scope, source, digest, and coverage commit; the host injects configured roots while the transport-neutral query/IPC client remains read-only. Common tests prove snapshot-bound pagination, stale-cursor rejection, reference privacy, replay authorization and writer rollback, actor and present-affiliation filtering, late workflow/team regrouping plus removal, ambiguity, generation retraction, repaired-gap recovery, and restart continuation without duplicate responses. Private native corpus-scale parity, the default usage migration, fixture-proven native team-to-actor correlation, effective model/effort/mode, and interaction lifecycle remain required before support promotion.
